esim.title: My eSIMs
esim.syncedStale: Last updated {time} — could not reach the network since
esim.installNowHint: Opens your phone's eSIM setup. Keep Wi-Fi on while it installs.
esim.installUnavailable: This phone cannot open the eSIM installer. Scan the QR code from another screen instead.
esim.scanHint: Or scan this code from another screen: Settings › Mobile service › Add eSIM.
esim.emptyBody: eSIMs you buy show up here, with how to install them.
esim.noPlans: No plans on sale here right now.
esim.perDayNote: {price} for {days} days, then {perDay} for each extra day. The cart shows the exact total.
esim.topupNone: No top-up is on offer for this plan right now.
esim.topupUnavailable: The network could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
esim.topupStackNote: The data and days are added to your current plan.
esim.topupAddonNote: This is a separate package beside your current plan, with its own data and days.

topupRefusal.not_supported: This plan cannot be topped up.
topupRefusal.not_issued: This eSIM has not been issued yet.
topupRefusal.expired: This plan has expired and can no longer be topped up. Buy a new eSIM instead.
topupRefusal.used_up: This plan's data is used up and it can no longer be topped up. Buy a new eSIM instead.
topupRefusal.profile_expired: This eSIM is no longer valid. Buy a new eSIM instead.

esim.payWaitingText: We are waiting for the payment to be confirmed. Some payments take a few minutes; your order appears in your orders as soon as it arrives.
esim.redirectNote: You will finish paying on the payment page, then come back here.
esim.devicesTitle: Does my phone take an eSIM?
esim.checkPhone: Does my phone take an eSIM?
esim.phoneUnsupported: This phone does not take an eSIM.
esim.phoneUnknown: We could not tell from this phone. Look it up below.
esim.deviceCaution: Where a phone was bought and whether it is locked to a carrier also decide. Check that your phone is unlocked before you travel.
esim.walletFee: A fee of {fixed} + {percent}% is added; the cart shows the total.
esim.walletOff: Adding money to your balance is not available at the moment.
esim.walletNote: Your balance pays for eSIMs and top-ups at checkout. Money added to it is not refunded to your card.
esim.inviteOffer: You earn {you} of every order your friends place.
esim.inviteOfferBoth: Your friends get {friend} off their first order, and you earn {you} of their orders.
esim.invited: {count, plural, =0 {No friends yet} one {# friend joined} other {# friends joined}}
esim.invitedNone: Share your link: friends who join with it show up here.
esim.referralsOff: Inviting friends is not available at the moment.
esim.kycWhy: Some countries' networks need to know who uses an eSIM. Verify once, and every eSIM that needs it can be bought.
esim.kycPending: Sent on {date}. We are checking it and will let you know.
esim.kycRejected: Not passed: {reason}. Please send your details again.
esim.kycClosed: Identity verification is not open yet.
esim.kycNoUploads: Documents cannot be uploaded at the moment.
esim.kycSent: Sent. We will tell you when it has been checked.
esim.kycPrivacy: Your documents are stored privately and seen only by our staff checking them.
esim.cancelBodyBalance: It stops working at once and cannot be installed. {refund} goes back to your balance ({fee} fee kept).
esim.cancelBodyOriginal: It stops working at once and cannot be installed. {refund} is refunded to your payment ({fee} fee kept).
esim.cancelDone: Cancelled. Your refund is on its way.
esim.cancelFailed: This eSIM can no longer be cancelled.
esim.cancelSupplierRefused: The network did not accept the cancellation. Please contact us.
esim.startHint: The plan starts on this day (UTC), not when you install it.
esim.signInTitle: Sign in to see your eSIMs
esim.signInBody: Your eSIMs, their usage and top-ups are kept in your account.
